hostNote: The gateway host is issued during builder onboarding; it is not published.
specNote: The requester flow is prose-only. combos-rfq-openapi.yaml covers the quoter/maker side and does not describe these endpoints.

auth.bodySignedVerbatim: Sign the exact serialized body sent on the wire; never reserialize a parsed body.

addressRoles.quote: POLY_ADDRESS is the EOA that owns the omnibus account credentials. Both signer_address and maker_address are the builder-controlled Deposit Wallet address.
addressRoles.note: The wire name signer_address is misleading in the documented Deposit Wallet flow: it carries the Trading Wallet, not the Account Signer. Only the POLY_ADDRESS header carries the Account Signer.

signerAddressByWalletType.note: Only signature type 3 collapses signer_address onto the Trading Wallet. The builders page documents signature_type 3, so its example shows the Deposit Wallet in both fields. POLY_ADDRESS stays the Account Signer for every type.

legs.idKind: underlying market outcome position IDs from Combo-enabled markets - not CLOB token IDs and not the derived Combo position IDs

createResponse.note: expires_at and builder_code are TOP LEVEL, beside rfq_id and status. They are not inside quote. leg_position_ids and the Combo position IDs are inside request, not top level.
createResponse.failureShape: A terminal result such as no quotes returns HTTP 200 with status FAILED and a nested error object.

quoteFieldMeanings.total_required_e6: exact requester balance required: collateral including fees for BUY, Combo shares for SELL
quoteFieldMeanings.net_receive_e6: Combo shares received for BUY; exact collateral proceeds after fees for SELL - use it rather than deriving from blended_price_e6

acceptRules: makerAmount comes from quote.maker_amount_e6 and takerAmount from quote.taker_amount_e6, for both directions.
tokenId is the returned Combo YES position ID (request.yes_position_id).
side is 0 for BUY and 1 for SELL.
order.builder must equal the top-level builder_code.
Sign under Polygon chain 137 and Exchange V3 0xe3333700cA9d93003F00f0F71f8515005F6c00Aa.
Deposit Wallets use signatureType 3 and an ERC-7739-wrapped signature.
Sign before expires_at; the acceptance window is not a fixed duration.

acceptResponse.takerOrderHash: the EIP-712 hash of the requester order
acceptResponse.lastLookWait: If last look is pending the gateway waits up to one second before returning; a returned AWAITING_MAKER_CONFIRMATION means keep fetching status.
acceptResponse.retrySafety: Retrying the same authenticated acceptance does not execute twice; the retry response may omit taker_order_hash.

statusResponse.note: One top-level status plus an optional tx_hash or error. Account headers only.

httpStatusMeanings.400: Invalid JSON, RFQ body, acceptance, or signed order
httpStatusMeanings.401: Missing or invalid account or builder authentication
httpStatusMeanings.403: Account authorization failed, or the builder key has no enabled builder code
httpStatusMeanings.409: RFQ state conflict, expired acceptance window, quote mismatch, or status read before acceptance
httpStatusMeanings.503: A required RFQ dependency is unavailable

errorEnvelope: A non-2xx response carries a stable code and a human-readable top-level error; a transport failure has no response at all.
outcomeRules: A business failure (no quote, maker decline, execution failure) returns HTTP 200 with status FAILED and a nested error.
Do not use the HTTP status alone to decide whether the trade filled.
rfq_id is the stable recovery identifier after a local timeout.
A local timeout is not a failed trade.
An interrupted create request is not proof that an RFQ was created; an interrupted acceptance is safe to retry before the quote expires.
